description: Ministry of Wildlife and Forest Resources Conservation - Amended the Ticket Fees and additional activities of the Zoological, Gardens
reasoning: This gazette notification amends fees charged at national zoological gardens under the National Zoological Gardens Act, No. 41 of 1982. It constitutes a regulatory matter where the Minister exercises powers granted by existing legislation to modify fee structures, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5) rather than a government personnel or structural change.
